content.text: {"headline":"Approve R2: overtime for 35 payments and 6 general agents plus callback, outage message and chat deflection lifts service level to 83.0% for 13:45-15:45 at ₹8,484.","why":"The payments surge is driven by the IMPS/NEFT hub outage (INC-20261023-2029). Customers are calling about debited transfers stuck in 'pending': payment_status_enquiry is up 66 calls and refund_status up 53. Staffing and attendance are at plan, so this is extra demand, not missing people. With no action, the window is predicted at 53.2% (payments 41.9%) with 14.7% abandoning. R2 is the cheapest policy-compliant plan that reaches the 80% target. It predicts 83.0% overall, payments 81.1%, general 86.3% and 3.1% abandons, with the rest of the day at 90.8%. The outage message and chat deflection take pressure off the outage-related calls. Callback, the overtime and the delayed breaks cover the remaining gap.","trade_offs":["Cost vs target: P3 is ₹1,530 cheaper (₹6,954) but lands just short at 79.8%, with payments at 77.4%. R2 is the cheapest plan that clears 80%.","R1 adds margin (85.2%, 2.5% abandons) but costs ₹1,800 more (₹10,284) for about 2 extra points.","The no-cost and low-cost plans (P1 ₹0, P2 ₹1,284, P4 ₹2,250) only reach 60-64%, leaving about 9-10% of callers abandoning during the outage.","General queue is not put at risk: R2 adds 6 general overtime agents and does not move staff off general, so general rises to 86.3% versus 74.8% with no action."],"watch":"R2 depends on overtime uptake, so confirm enough of the 35 payments agents accept before 14:15. Watch the P2 incident: if the hub is not fixed by 15:45, demand will continue past the planned window and the plan will need extending. If it is fixed early, release overtime and stop the outage message."}
